summary: Master the art of Branding and Reputation Management in our hospitality training course. Boost your skills and stand out in the competitive industry.
lede: Hospitality branding and reputation management helps managers and guest-facing teams align brand promises with guests’ actual experience. Participants learn to define positioning and service standards, build feedback and review workflows, respond to complaints and online criticism, and report on reputation performance with clear escalation and service recovery processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across the hospitality sector who are committed to managing brand identity and reputation.
audience: Hotel and resort managers and department heads
Restaurant managers, supervisors, and operations leads
Guest relations, front office, and customer experience
Owners, general managers, and regional managers
Tourism operators and tour company managers
Public sector tourism and hospitality promotion officers
modules: Foundations of Hospitality Branding That Guests Actually Believe
Brand Positioning and Identity for Hotels, Restaurants, and Tourism Brands
Guest Experience Design Across the Full Journey
Service Standards, SOPs, and Experience Quality Control
Responding to Online Reviews with Control and Strategy
Complaint Handling and Service Recovery That Protects the Brand
Social Media and Viral Risk Management
Brand Culture and Staff Alignment in High-Turnover Environments
Measuring Brand Performance and Proving Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of hospitality operations and basic experience in guest interaction. Familiarity with social media platforms and review sites is beneficial.
